lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern posterior to the gills and extending along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like coordinate system across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Dominant horizontal ridge feature visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance transition from light above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Small teleost fish with yellow and black vertical bands positioned in the water column immediately anterior to the shark's rostrum.
